response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff-level polyglot engineer with direct, recent experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, perfectly aligning with the company's AI-native focus. He also possesses deep expertise in high-throughput distributed systems, having built microservices handling millions of requests per second. However, he lacks the must-have Python experience, though his extensive background across diverse languages (TypeScript, DLang, C++, Java) suggests he could adapt rapidly.
strengths: Direct experience building AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) code generators.
Proven expertise in high-throughput distributed systems, handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby.
Strong Staff-level technical leadership and ownership, including founding an open-source platform and driving agile software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD).
concerns: No Python experience mentioned on the resume, which is listed as a strong must-have for the role.
Considerable focus on niche languages (DLang) over mainstream backend languages in several past roles.
While experienced in infrastructure, explicit mention of out-of-hours on-call or incident response capability is missing.
